rule: Classify table publication state and mapping purpose before applying release/invalidation requirements

paths.nonleaf_removal: published child: clear parent -> walk flush return -> free (previous round)

paths.allocation_failure: zero bytes unmapped, old block preserved
paths.gather: adjacent same-size ADD accumulates; explicit sync emits leaf=true, disjoint/granule change syncs previous range
